description: This file defines an Android Fragment (`AttractionListFragment`) that displays a list of tourist attractions sorted by distance based on the user's current location. It includes inner classes for adapting the data to a RecyclerView (`AttractionAdapter`) and handling item views (`ViewHolder`). The fragment registers a BroadcastReceiver to update the list when location changes occur and uses external libraries like Glide for image loading.

classes.name: AttractionListFragment
classes.description: Main fragment displaying a list of attractions sorted by proximity. Manages location updates and data loading.

classes.name: AttractionAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter subclass that binds Attraction data to the list UI and handles item clicks.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: Holder for individual list item views, managing UI components and click interactions.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's view, sets up RecyclerView, and loads attraction data based on current location.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the BroadcastReceiver for location updates.

methods.name: mBroadcastReceiver.onReceive
methods.description: Handles location update broadcasts and refreshes the attractions list.

methods.name: loadAttractionsFromLocation
methods.description: Loads and sorts attractions based on the current location.

methods.name: AttractionAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds attraction data to UI components, loads images, and sets distance info.

methods.name: AttractionAdapter.onItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events to launch detail activity.

methods.name: ViewHolder.constructor
methods.description: Initializes UI components for a list item and sets up click listener.

methods.name: ViewHolder.onClick
methods.description: Delegates click events to the adapter's item click handler.
